items.label: WHY CHOOSE AKUMAKA G62 SMART WATCH? ① Stylish Design
items.value: Chic blush pink finish that complements any outfit; ② Bluetooth Calls & Messages: Stay connected hands-free; ③ Health Monitoring: Track heart rate, SpO₂, sleep, and BP in real time; ④ Fitness Modes: Multiple sports tracking to meet your goals; ⑤ Long Battery Life: 1000mAh battery for extended use; ⑥ Free App Support: Easy setup and detailed health insights; ⑦ Wide Compatibility: Works with Android and iPhone

items.label: Elegant Smart Watches for Women
items.value: This smartwatch comes with a blush pink metal frame and a 1.83" HD screen, which is elegant and stylish overall. 2 different styles of watch bands (1 metal, 1 silicone) are perfect for work, casual wear and special occasions. In addition, there are more than 200 watch face styles to choose from, and you can also upload photos to customize your unique watch face

items.label: Continuous Health Monitor
items.value: With the latest touch chip CST816D, high-sensitivity G-sensor STK8321 and PPG heart rate sensor HX3918 built in, AKUMAKA smart watches can monitor heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure and sleep accurately. The sleep tracker turns on automatically at night, and the other three can be measured automatically or manually at any time

items.label: Bluetooth Calls Messages Notifications
items.value: After connect your phone and smartwatch, you can easily make and answer calls directly on your wrist, without holding your phone all the time. The watch will also receive real-time messages or app notifications from SMS, Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram and so on. Bluetooth alerts is convenient, but note that you can't edit or reply to messages from your smart watch

items.label: 5ATM Fitness Watch with 110+ Sports Modes
items.value: As a daily wearable activity tracker, it keeps recording your steps, distance and calories burned, and no need to take it off even if you sweat, wash your hands or it rains. This fitness watch supports 110+ sports modes, of which 8+1 sports modes are built into the watch system. No matter you like outdoor or indoor workouts, it will help you stay active and fit

items.label: Smartwatch for Android iPhone Compatible
items.value: This smartwatch is compatible with Android (versions 5.0 and above) and iPhone (iOS 9.0 and above), covering almost all smartphone models on the market. After a simple pairing connection, you can receive calls and notifications via Bluetooth, use voice assistants and music control, and more

items.label: Perfect Gifts for Women
items.value: The women watch combines modern aesthetics with elegance, available in a variety of colors and styles to suit different tastes. Whether it's a birthday, holiday, anniversary or a special milestone, surprise your mother, wife, girlfriend or daughter with a treat
